metadata.description: Citation-backed YouTube research: transcripts to a local corpus, then cited briefs and lab specs

plugins.name: youtube-research
plugins.description: Turn YouTube channels into a citation-backed research corpus on disk, then synthesize cited briefs and lab specs from it. Every non-obvious claim resolves to a second-accurate deep link. Requires Node 18+ and yt-dlp on PATH; no API keys and no external services.
